scope: Nine unchanged original finite CPU radiation/transfer controls only; no device/frame, full P4/science, Mandatory or release qualification.

SpectralValidationTests.PlanckSpectralRa.reference: Independent 2*h*c^2/[lambda^5*expm1(h*c/(lambda*k*T))] with original literal SI h,c,k, not production Planck coefficients.
SpectralValidationTests.PlanckSpectralRa.assertion: Original relative error <2e-14 (denominator max(abs(expected),1e-300)); no all-wavelength/all-temperature bound.

SpectralValidationTests.WienPeakMatchesI.reference: Original 120-iteration golden-section maximization of independent Planck on [50e-9,20e-6] m.
SpectralValidationTests.WienPeakMatchesI.assertion: Original relative error <2e-8; no new root solver or executable reference.

SpectralValidationTests.StefanBoltzmannE.reference: Original 32768-panel midpoint integral in log(lambda), log limits -20.72326583694641 to -6.907755278982137 (1 nm to 1 mm), independent Planck times lambda and hemisphere factor pi.
SpectralValidationTests.StefanBoltzmannE.assertion: Original relative error <2e-7 against production sigma*T^4; finite integration bounds retained.

SpectralValidationTests.BlackbodyLawsRej.reference: Original invalid wavelength/temperature refusals; deep Wien lambda1e-20 m/T1 K exact zero; finite extreme Rayleigh-Jeans lambda1e100 m/T1e300 K compares original c1/c2*1e-100 at relative<2e-13. This extreme-limit expected coefficient ratio is production-derived.
SpectralValidationTests.BlackbodyLawsRej.assertion: Original overflow refusal at lambda1e-300 m,T=c2/1e-297 and Stefan(max_double); no new domain points.

SpectralValidationTests.KerrDiskTransfer.reference: Original separately written equatorial BL g_tt/g_tphi/g_phiphi, circular Omega, normalized u^t and nu=u^t*(E-Omega*Lz); same independent contraction for ZAMO Omega=-g_tphi/g_phiphi.
SpectralValidationTests.KerrDiskTransfer.assertion: Original absolute 2e-15 emitter/zamo frequencies and full_g/zamo_g; one fixed tuple, no arbitrary-latitude claim.

SpectralValidationTests.ZamoBranchRemain.assertion: Original static ratio(gtt_emit=1/3,gtt_observer=-1) declines; Kerr transfer exists, zamo_frequency>0 and zamo_g finite. No additional numeric oracle inferred.

SpectralValidationTests.OpticallyThinGre.reference: Original first-order 1-exp(-tau)=tau+O(tau^2) ratios at the one thin layer; no E2/polarised-transport rerun.
SpectralValidationTests.OpticallyThinGre.assertion: Original positive absorbed fraction/emission, absorbed/tau near1 at1e-14, negative tau declines; accumulated RGB/tau near[1,.5,.25] at1e-14.

SpectralRadianceTest.BlackbodyBinsDelega.reference: Facade/delegation and unit conversion against production TryPlanckSpectralRadiancePerMetre, not an independent 32-bin physical oracle.
SpectralRadianceTest.BlackbodyBinsDelega.assertion: Original EXPECT_DOUBLE_EQ L[bin]=production_per_metre*1e-9 (per nm); temperatures0,-1,+Inf,NaN yield exact total energy0.

SpectralEmissionTest.BolometricDiskAutho.reference: Original algebraic bolometric authority check: invariant I_nu/nu^3 contributes g^3 and dnu_observer=g*dnu_emitter contributes one g, hence g^4.
SpectralEmissionTest.BolometricDiskAutho.assertion: Original EXPECT_FLOAT_EQ ObservedBolometricIntensity(emitted,g)=emitted*g*g*g*g at one tuple; no integrated disk/frame or pixel accuracy claim.

ledger_scope.excluded: Previously completed E2/polarised witnesses, unselected P4 controls, all device and frame work.

primary_rows.speed of light in vacuum: speed of light in vacuum                                    299 792 458              (exact)                  m s^-1
primary_rows.first radiation constant for spectral ra: first radiation constant for spectral radiance              1.191 042 972... e-16    (exact)                  W m^2 sr^-1
primary_rows.second radiation constant: second radiation constant                                   1.438 776 877... e-2     (exact)                  m K
primary_rows.Stefan-Boltzmann constant: Stefan-Boltzmann constant                                   5.670 374 419... e-8     (exact)                  W m^-2 K^-4
primary_rows.Wien wavelength displacement law constan: Wien wavelength displacement law constant                   2.897 771 955... e-3     (exact)                  m K

nist_2022.scope: Small unchanged official plaintext table; provenance and source-constant audit only. Original executable test references/assertions remain unchanged.
nist_2022.precision_note: h, c and k are exact SI defining constants. Listed sigma and wavelength Wien b have ellipses: source 5.670374419e-8 and 2.897771955e-3 retain their existing truncated decimal representations of exact-derived quantities, not new exact finite decimals.

reference.nist_scope: Official table binds coefficient provenance only; no pixel, all-radiation, or whole-domain accuracy claim.

derivations_for_review_only.Wien: Positive root x of5*(1-exp(-x))=x; b=(h*c/k)/x. Original executable reference remains golden-section Planck maximum.
derivations_for_review_only.hemisphere_exitance: pi*integral_0^infinity B_lambda dlambda=[2*pi^5*k^4/(15*h^3*c^2)]*T^4. Original executable reference remains bounded log-lambda quadrature.
derivations_for_review_only.bolometric: Invariant I_nu/nu^3 plus frequency measure dnu gives g^4; one algebraic float test only.

reference.source_composition_boundary: Root reviewed blackbody law, constants, transfer composition and facade units; finite source algebra review is not exhaustive or a machine proof. No new numerical reference implementation or threshold.

historical_execution.reuse_boundary: Seven selected SpectralValidation cases have historical passes at5e70607 with different ELF hashes; no matching current-ELF selected execution found in preserved XML. No relabelling as current.
